sources.articleTitle: Jharkhand tribal activist Nisha Bhagat’s last rites to be held in Gumla, BJP demands CBI probe
Why death of tribal activist Nisha Bhagat has sparked row in Jharkhand

headline: Jharkhand Faces Political Unrest Following Tribal Activist's Death
seoTitle: Tribal Activist Nisha Bhagat Dies In Jharkhand
metaDescription: Tribal activist Nisha Bhagat has died in Jharkhand, prompting political conflict and calls for a central investigation into her allegations of harassment.
aiSummaryBullets: Tribal activist Nisha Bhagat passed away on November 6 following public claims of harassment.
Bhagat had previously alleged in a live broadcast that the state government and land brokers targeted her.
The Bharatiya Janata Party has officially requested that the Central Bureau of Investigation handle the case.
aiContextParagraph: The death of tribal activist Nisha Bhagat in the state of Jharkhand has resulted in significant political friction. Before her passing on November 6, Bhagat utilized a Facebook Live session to accuse the current state administration led by Hemant Soren, alongside various land brokers, of subjecting her to harassment. Following these events, her last rites are scheduled to take place in the Gumla district. The opposition party, the Bharatiya Janata Party, has formally demanded an investigation by the Central Bureau of Investigation into the circumstances surrounding her death and the allegations she made prior to the incident. Local authorities and relevant political entities are currently involved in the unfolding situation as public attention remains focused on the validity of her claims and the official response from the Jharkhand government regarding the status of the investigation.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to multiple reports from prominent national outlets and active demands for a high-level central investigation.
